paragraphs: 2 former Mustangs appeared in professional games on Friday for 2 clubs across 2 levels, with Alejandro Garza producing the night's most notable performance.
The game's turning point came in the seventh, when Alejandro Garza delivered a go-ahead walk, on a 3-2 pitch from David Bracho.
Alejandro Garza went 2-for-3, 1 double, 3 RBI, 1 run scored, 2 walks, 1 stolen base.
Hill City Howlers beat Myrtle Beach Pelicans, 11-7.

Andrew Alvarez also appeared for Washington Nationals. He worked 5.2 innings, allowing 2 hits and 2 earned runs, with 1 walk and 4 strikeouts. He started at P. Washington Nationals fell to New York Mets, 1-4.
